explanation: Snoopy made the line famous again by typing it at the start of his novels in Peanuts, and a contest for deliberately dreadful opening sentences was named after Bulwer-Lytton.
learnMore: It was a dark and stormy night

claims.text: Edward Bulwer-Lytton's 1830 novel Paul Clifford opens with 'It was a dark and stormy night'.
Charles Dickens, Edgar Allan Poe and Walter Scott did not write Paul Clifford.
In Peanuts, Snoopy often begins his novels with 'It was a dark and stormy night'.
The Bulwer-Lytton Fiction Contest, a competition for deliberately bad opening sentences, is named after him.
